about_the_game:
Jonás is an otaku who lives peacefully watching anime and reading manga.

But one fateful day, he discovers online that his city has been ravaged by a mysterious virus that turns people into zombies.

"The city is under quarantine," the online news says...

And soon, it will be wiped out by an airstrike.

Now Jonás must face the horror...

He's clumsy, slow, and can barely run a few meters without needing a break.
Armed only with his wits (and whatever junk he finds), he must fight off hordes of zombies and mutant monsters in a pixelated city full of horrors.

  • Find stronger weapons to kill the undead.

  • Solve absurd puzzles set by a "jerk" in the police station.

  • Find the survivors.

  • Escape underground laboratories.

  • Uncover the dark truth behind the cursed city's fate.

All this in a retro-style pixelated world, with Japanese voiceovers.

A parody of classic survival horror games, full of humor and terror.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains violent scenes and deaths, all in an unrealistic pixel format.
